thread:
support_jen: Escalation for ACME (acme-ml). Customer seeing intermittent 500s + token-level latency spikes on Dedicated EU. Request id: req-0a1b2c3d. Need repro artifacts: pod logs, node dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshot, kubectl describe, and a curl repro.

eng_oncall_alex: On it. Which pod + namespace?

support_jen: pod: acme-ml-runtime-7f8b9, ns: acme-ml-prod. Approx time: 2026-03-11T14:23Z. Endpoint: POST /v1/generate.

infra_maya: I'll collect node artifacts. Which node?

support_jen: gpunode-eu-3a. Please get dmesg, kubelet journal, /var/log/kern.log, and a GPU snapshot. Also container logs.

runtime_zoe: For curl repro use this (replace $TOKEN):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Request-Id: req-0a1b2c3d" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  https://dedicated-eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Hello"}'
```

support_jen: Added to ticket SUP-4921. Customer reports heavy batching before the spike.

eng_oncall_alex: Can you run: `kubectl logs -n acme-ml-prod pod/acme-ml-runtime-7f8b9 -c runtime --since=2h > runtime.log` and upload to the sup bucket?

support_jen: runtime.log uploaded.
s3-bot: Upload complete: https://s3.redwood.ai/sup-4921/runtime.log

infra_maya: Node snapshot commands I ran:
```bash
sudo dmesg -T > dmesg.txt
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 10000 > kubelet.log
nvidia-smi -q -x -d MEMORY > nvidia_memory.xml
sudo cp /var/log/kern.log kern.log
```
I also collected `kubectl describe pod acme-ml-runtime-7f8b9 -n acme-ml-prod` and packaged everything.

support_jen: Node bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/sup-4921/node-bundle.tar.gz

runtime_zoe: Also captured MIG / topology: `nvidia-smi mig -l` and `nvidia-smi -q`. Recommend uploading `nvidia-smi -q` in case of thermal or ECC errors.

cs_luis: ACME passed a short-lived API token for repro (DMed to support_jen). They asked for an ETA.

eng_oncall_alex: Quick look at node logs shows kernel OOM events around 14:22-14:25 on gpunode-eu-3a; possible eviction pressure. I pulled the request trace for req-0a1b2c3d and see a long GPU queue wait then decode fallback:
```text
trace: req-0a1b2c3d -> runtime-1 -> gpu-queue wait 2300ms -> decode -> respond 500
```

runtime_zoe: That pattern matches KV-cache regeneration under heavy batching. Can you capture pod env so I can mirror settings? Run: `kubectl exec -n acme-ml-prod pod/acme-ml-runtime-7f8b9 -c runtime -- printenv | grep -E "MODEL|BATCH|KV|CACHE" > env.txt`

support_jen: Env captured: MODEL=redwood-13b, BATCH_SIZE=16, KV_CACHE=on. env.txt uploaded to bundle.

infra_maya: Created debug bundle with node + pod + traces: sup-4921-bundle-20260311.tar.gz
s3-bot: Bundle uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/sup-4921/sup-4921-bundle-20260311.tar.gz

eng_oncall_alex: Assigning to runtime team. Zoe will take lead on RCA.

runtime_zoe: I'll reproduce locally with the same model + BATCH_SIZE. If I need direct node access I'll coordinate with infra_maya.

cs_luis: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer. ETA for initial RCA 2-4 hours.

support_jen: Thanks all — ticket updated with artifacts and links. If anyone finds a quick mitigation (reduce batch size or pin model variant), please note in ticket.
